name: sdl3-input
description: Pinned third-party binary versions for the native controller-input addon. Read by scripts/build/fetch-sdl3.mjs and scripts/ensure-sdl3.mjs — bump these fields to change the pinned version, never hardcode a version in a script. "version" is the addon's own build version: it names the prebuilt package attached to the app's own GitHub Releases (sdl3-input-<version>-<platform>-<arch>.tar.gz) — bump it when the addon's C++ changes in a way that needs a new build.
